info.name: Fleet Monitoring - SPEC-002 Read
info.description: Read path BFF: GET /api/fleet/positions (keyset, plate filter), GET /api/vehicles/{plate}/history, GET /healthz/metrics, SSE fleet:position (curl). Run against docker compose LB http://localhost:8080 (via nginx) or direct api http://localhost:8083. Prereq: POST telemetría via SPEC-001 first (GTP890 etc) and zones via POST /api/zones when Step3 done.

request.description: AC-001: snapshot última posición por placa, keyset 2+1, next_cursor opaque base64 plate|received_at, no OFFSET

exec: pm.test('has vehicles and next_cursor', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.vehicles).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.vehicles.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.next_cursor).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('no OFFSET, has status lat lon 6dec', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); j.vehicles.forEach(v=>{ pm.expect(v.plate).to.match(/^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{3}$/); pm.expect(v.status).to.be.oneOf(['moving','idle','alert']); if(v.lat!==null) pm.expect(v.lat.toString().split('.')[1]?.length ?? 0).to.be.at.most(6); }); });

request.description: AC-001 page2 con cursor base64 plate|received_at, debe devolver restante y no usar OFFSET
AC-001 con ?plate=GTP980 solo ese, sin plate=todos

exec: pm.test('solo GTP980', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); j.vehicles.forEach(v=> pm.expect(v.plate).to.eql('GTP980')); });

request.description: AC-002 history DESC, keyset, from/to RFC3339

exec: pm.test('5 points DESC', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.points.length).to.eql(5); for(let i=1;i<j.points.length;i++) pm.expect(new Date(j.points[i].received_at) <= new Date(j.points[i-1].received_at)).to.be.true; });
pm.test('has breaker', () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.breaker).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.nats).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.db).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.sendRequest({url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl')+'/api/metrics', method:'GET'}, (err,res)=>{ pm.test('metrics 200', ()=> pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200)); pm.test('has metrics', ()=> pm.expect(res.text()).to.include('breaker')); });

request.description: SSE text/event-stream fleet:position todos. En Postman no soporta EventSource: usar curl: curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' http://localhost:8080/api/fleet/positions/stream y curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' 'http://localhost:8080/api/fleet/positions/stream?plate=GTP980' solo ese. Ver todos reconecta sin plate. Expect event: fleet:position id: seq data: {plate,lat,lon,speed,received_at} + :ping 15s + retry:5000
